Verify that the [DONE] sentinel signal properly terminates the stream

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say done\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stream\":true}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chatStream(request: _request)
var chunks: [LiterLlm.ChatCompletionChunk] = []
        for try await _chunk in result { chunks.append(_chunk) }
debugPrint(result.streamComplete)
debugPrint(result.streamContent)
debugPrint(result.noChunksAfterDone)
```
